title: Hub 0.4.38 links to Agent Chat metadata pages
original_report: The Hobbyka Hub 0.4.38 manifest sends its website, privacy, and terms links to Hobbyka Agent Chat instead of Hub-owned pages.
expected: Every public metadata link in the Hub manifest identifies Hobbyka Hub and opens a Hub-owned page.
actual: All three links in 0.4.38 identified or opened Hobbyka Agent Chat resources.
environment: macOS regression fixture, Node.js 24, Hobbyka Hub 0.4.38
reproduction: A focused manifest regression compares the three public links with exact Hub-owned destinations.
failure_signal: The focused test failed because websiteURL ended in /plugins/hobbyka-agent-chat and both policy links targeted the Agent Chat repository path.
root_cause: Hub copied Agent Chat interface metadata into its own manifest and had no cross-plugin link regression.
fix_summary: Replaced the three links, added Hub-owned privacy and terms documents, bumped the candidate to 0.4.39, and kept the exact-link regression in the Hub suite.
why_causal: The manifest now owns each destination and the same exact assertion changes from exit 1 to exit 0.

fix_files.summary: Hub-owned website, privacy, and terms destinations.

checks.name: Focused regression
checks.detail: The same command changed from exit 1 to exit 0.

limitations: The 0.4.39 candidate still requires validation through the pinned Windows runner; the Windows host was unreachable over LAN and VPN during this capture.
notes: No release, merge, or publish was performed.
